name: @ordewell/web
description: Ordewell local API server — the daemon the Ordewell CLI and TUI talk to.
author: Alessandro Costanzo Ciano

scripts.build: tsup server/main.ts --format cjs --clean --external hono --external @hono/node-server --external ws --external @ordewell/core --tsconfig tsconfig.json
scripts.build:server: tsup server/main.ts --format cjs --clean --external hono --external @hono/node-server --external ws --external @ordewell/core --tsconfig tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: tsup server/main.ts --format cjs --clean --external hono --external @hono/node-server --external ws --external @ordewell/core --tsconfig tsconfig.json --watch
